---
title: Typst with logo false (format level)
format:
  typst:
    output-ext: typ
    logo: false
brand:
  color:
    primary: "#1f6f8b"
  logo:
    images:
      quarto:
        path: quarto.png
        alt: quarto logo
    small: quarto
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'primary: rgb\("#1f6f8b"\)'
        -
          - 'set page\(background'
          - 'image\("[^"]*quarto\.png"'
---

`logo: false` removes the brand logo in Typst output, while the rest of the
brand still applies (#15311).
